description: System overview of a Victron GX device (Cerbo GX, Venus GX, Color Control GX, Ekrano GX)
source: Victron Energy, CCGX Modbus TCP register list 3.81
notes: Registers of the com.victronenergy.system service of the GX Modbus TCP server (Settings > Integrations > Modbus TCP server).
The unit ID of this service is 100.
All registers are holding registers (FC03; FC06/FC16 for the writable ones).

registers.name: Serial (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Serial; System value -> MAC address of CCGX (represented as string)

registers.name: CCGX Relay 2 state
registers.description: D-Bus /Relay/1/State; Relay 1 is available on Venus GX only

registers.name: PV - AC-coupled on output L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnOutput/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on the output

registers.name: PV - AC-coupled on input L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnGrid/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on the input

registers.name: PV - AC-coupled on generator L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnGenset/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on a generator. Bit theoretic; this will never be used

registers.name: AC Consumption L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Consumption/L1/Power; Power supplied by system to loads

registers.name: Grid L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Grid/L1/Power; Power supplied by Grid to system

registers.name: Genset L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Genset/L1/Power; Power supplied by Genset tot system

registers.name: Active input source
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/ActiveIn/Source; 0 indicates that there is an active input, but it is not configured under Settings → System setup

registers.name: GX firmware major version
registers.description: Render in hexadecimal to get the text version

registers.name: GX firmware beta release
registers.description: This is zero for official releases

registers.name: Battery Voltage (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Battery/Voltage; Battery Voltage determined from different measurements. In order of preference: BMV-voltage (V), Multi-DC-Voltage (CV), MPPT-DC-Voltage (ScV), Charger voltage

registers.name: Battery Current (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Battery/Current; Postive: battery begin charged. Negative: battery being discharged

registers.name: Battery Power (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Battery/Power; Postive: battery begin charged. Negative: battery being discharged

registers.name: Battery State of Charge (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Battery/Soc; Best battery state of charge, determined from different measurements

registers.name: PV - DC-coupled power
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Pv/Power; Summation of output power of all connected Solar Chargers

registers.name: PV - DC-coupled current
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Pv/Current; Summation of output current of all connected Solar Chargers

registers.name: DC System Power
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/System/Power; Power supplied by Battery to system

registers.name: VE.Bus charge current (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Vebus/Current; Current flowing from the Multi to the dc system. Negative: the other way around

registers.name: VE.Bus charge power (System)
registers.description: D-Bus /Dc/Vebus/Power; System value etc. AND: Positive: power flowing from the Multi to the dc system. Negative: the other way around

registers.name: Power between meter and inverter/charger, L1
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/ConsumptionOnInput/L1/Power; This is the power shown on the overview in the Loads box

registers.name: Power between meter and inverter/charger, L2
Power between meter and inverter/charger, L3
Power on output of inverter/charger, L1
Power on output of inverter/charger, L2
Power on output of inverter/charger, L3
PV - AC-coupled on output L1 (884)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnOutput/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on the output

registers.name: PV - AC-coupled on input L1 (890)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnGrid/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on the input

registers.name: PV - AC-coupled on generator L1 (896)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/PvOnGenset/L1/Power; Summation of all AC-Coupled PV Inverters on a generator. Bit theoretic; this will never be used

registers.name: AC Consumption L1 (902)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Consumption/L1/Power; Power supplied by system to loads

registers.name: Grid L1 (908)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Grid/L1/Power; Power supplied by Grid to system

registers.name: Genset L1 (914)
registers.description: D-Bus /Ac/Genset/L1/Power; Power supplied by Genset tot system

enum.0: System is not capable of doing DynamicEss
enum.1: System is capable of doing DynamicEss

enum.0: No restrictions between battery and the grid
enum.1: Grid to battery energy flow is restricted
enum.2: Battery to grid energy flow is restricted
enum.3: No energy flow between battery and grid

registers.name: Used strategy for current time slot
The set target SOC for this time slot
